<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Dodoria''' is one of Frieza's henchmen. In [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]], the raid of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]], he leads the fourth wave alongside [[Special:MyLanguage/Zarbon|Zarbon]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In raids == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Dodoria is one of the two bosses of wave 4, with [[Special:MyLanguage/Zarbon|Zarbon]] and 15 [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Soldier|Frieza Soldiers]]. Both bosses stay dormant until the soldiers are dead, but attacking one wakes it up early. Like every raid boss, he glows red.

<!--T:9-->
In the raid he has 7,000 health, 60 melee damage and 50 ki damage, and fights on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|Smart]] AI tier. These are the defaults, before the story difficulty multiplier of the player who started the raid (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids#Difficulty|Raids]]); the number of participants doesn't change them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* '''Flight:''' Dodoria flies and follows you into the air.
* '''Oozaru Beam:''' a pale ki beam.
* Unlike Zarbon, he doesn't dodge.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
Dodoria drops nothing. Clearing the raid rewards everyone still fighting (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion#Rewards|Frieza's Invasion]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]], the quest '''The Cruel Dodoria''' has you defeat him on Namek's Ajissa Plains.
</translate>
